scene.speaker: oliver
scene.bubble: I'm writing a song with a verse for every month of the year. Which month has the best sound, Kili?
scene.intro: Oliver is writing a song with a verse for every month of the year. January is cold and quiet, in February there is a school party, in March the snow melts. April rhymes with nothing useful. In August everybody is away, and in October the wind returns. His birthday is on the ninth of June, so June gets the best verse. When is YOUR birthday? Add your month to the song!

data.voice_note: Voces: Oliver (músico) y Kili (elige con graznidos — narrado por Oliver).
data.script: Oliver: Okay, the song of the year! January gets a slow verse, because everyone is sleepy after the holidays. … Oliver: In March, the music grows like the flowers — violins! … Oliver: August is a big drum solo, hot like the summer sun. … Oliver: For October I want the sound of falling leaves… maybe a soft guitar. … Oliver: And December? Bells, of course! Everybody sings in December. … Oliver: Kili says his favourite verse is October, because that's his birthday month!
